senses.definition: To count as in a number, rank, or series; to estimate by rank or quality; to place by estimation; to account; to esteem; to repute.

senses.definition: (colloquial) To conclude, as by an enumeration and balancing of chances; hence, to think; to suppose; -- followed by an objective clause
examples: I reckon he won't try that again.
I’ve just heard from the repairman: it's going to cost £1000. I'd reckoned it’d be £500 at most.

quotes.text: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

senses.definition: (intransitive) To make an enumeration or computation; to engage in numbering or computing.
To come to an accounting; to draw up or settle accounts; to examine and strike the balance of debt and credit; to adjust relations of desert or penalty.
